Camila (PM): Quick sync — post-launch triage for v1.3. Metrics show two user-impacting crashes (CRASH-A, CRASH-B) plus ~8 small UX asks. We need a scope call: option A = ship fixes for both crashes + up to 3 UX polish items; option B = fix CRASH-A only and push 5 UX items. Need owners and rollout criteria. @Maria, @Jason, @Lee, @Anika any hot takes?
Maria Chen: My vote is A — crashes hit session retention, so they’re higher priority. We should gate on roll-forward only after 24h staged canary telemetry looks good.
Jason Park: +1 to A. Also want to avoid too many UI tweaks in the same patch — each tweak increases test matrix. Recommend top 3 UXs be ones with clear acceptance criteria.
Lee Ortega: From infra side, two fixes in one deploy is fine if we keep canary + kill-switch. Suggest canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 6 hours, with automated error-rate rollback at +3x baseline. I can own the rollout runbook.
Anika Rao: Customer ops flagged CRASH-B as hitting 3 enterprise customers (high touch). If we only do CRASH-A now, we'll hear complaints. Also one UX ask (keyboard focus) is actually a regression and should be in the patch.
Camila (PM): Sounds like consensus toward A. Need to pick top-3 UXs: propose (1) keyboard focus fix, (2) toast timing adjustment, (3) compact list bounce (visual). Any objections?
Jason Park: Ok for those 3. I can QA CRASH-A and keyboard focus. But I’m limited on time — can we have pair-testing for CRASH-B?
Maria Chen: I’ll take CRASH-B QA and write the checklist for repro and post-merge smoke. Will add repro steps + a short unit test where possible.
Lee Ortega: I’ve added the canary policy to the runbook and a rollback snippet: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/redwood-api --to-revision=$(kubectl rollout history deploy/redwood-api | tail -n2 | head -n1 | awk '{print $1}')` — keep this handy during canary.
deploy-bot: Canary window opened for 5% traffic target — monitor: /deploys/v1.3-hotfix-canary
Anika Rao: Timelines: target branch cut today EOD, QA tomorrow, canary Tuesday morning, full rollout Tuesday afternoon if green. Customers will be notified after canary passes.
Camila (PM): Owners: Jason -> CRASH-A + keyboard focus QA; Maria -> CRASH-B QA + smoke checklist; Lee -> rollout; Anika -> customer comms; Camila -> overall sign-off and priority trade decisions.
Jason Park: I'll update the test doc and ping infra when ready for canary. Also flagging one risk: third-party analytics lib change might be the root cause of CRASH-A — if it’s deep we may need a quick revert strategy.
Maria Chen: Noted. I’ll add a step to validate analytics payloads during QA.
Camila (PM): Decision recorded: go with option A (both crashes + top-3 UXs). Acceptance: pass QA + 24h staged canary with error-rate <= 3x baseline and no user-reported regressions from pilot customers. If canary fails, immediate rollback and follow-up postmortem. Thanks all — I'll write the release note draft and PR checklist now. :thumbsup:
Jason Park: thanks — will raise PRs and tag reviewers.
Maria Chen: adding checklist items to the ticket now.
Anika Rao: I'll prep the customer advisory for the pilot group.
Lee Ortega: Standby on the rollout channel.
Camila (PM): closing this thread — follow-ups in the v1.3-hotfix ticket.
